nodes.label: Analytics Tab 1: Overview (KPIs + trends landing view)
nodes.rationale: Live listeners, total plays, unique listeners, avg session duration, growth %; line plays-over-time, genre donut, top-5 bar, trending songs table

nodes.label: Analytics Tab 2: Stations (per-station comparison + drill-down)
nodes.rationale: Sortable all-stations table with online/offline status; drill-down to daily plays line and peak-hours heatmap

nodes.label: Analytics Tab 3: Songs & Artists (top tracks, 24h/7d toggle)
nodes.rationale: Tracks song detection metadata source (Zetta / ICY), top songs by play count, avg listener duration per song, top artists bar

nodes.label: Analytics Tab 4: Genres & Regions (audience breakdown)
nodes.rationale: Plays and unique listeners by genre and region; useful for deciding which stations to add or promote

nodes.label: Analytics Tab 5: Station Health (uptime, status grid)
nodes.rationale: Online/offline status, uptime %, last seen, metadata quality (Zetta / ICY / Icecast) - for catching stream problems early
